dt-option.name: stateRestore.bookmark

type.description: Configuration object for the bookmark feature of StateRestore.

dt-option.description:
This object is the container for the configuration of StateRestore's bookmarking feature. To enable this feature you must set `-init stateRestore.bookmark.src`, but it also has other parameters that can be used to customise as you need:
* `-init stateRestore.bookmark.match` - Match on state id or name * `-init stateRestore.bookmark.src` - Query / search parameter or hash to identify the state * `-init stateRestore.bookmark.update` - Control URL rewriting when changing state.
Please refer to the documentation for each for full details.

example.title: Enable bookmark support, using a query string parameter
Enable bookmark support using a URL hash
